subject: English
title: Year 7 English: Half-term 6 (Reading review: character and theme)

questions.question:
Read the passage.

"Grandad's allotment was his kingdom. He ruled it from a sagging deckchair, a flask of tea at his elbow, pointing his walking stick at weeds as if they were traitors. 'Patience,' he would say, whenever I asked when the tomatoes would be ready. 'Good things grow slowly.' I thought he meant tomatoes. It took me years to realise he didn't."

r"Grandad's allotment was his kingdom." What does this metaphor suggest?
options: The allotment was where he felt in charge and proud
questions.answer: The allotment was where he felt in charge and proud
questions.explanation: Calling it his kingdom shows pride and control.

questions.question:
Read the passage.

"Grandad's allotment was his kingdom. He ruled it from a sagging deckchair, a flask of tea at his elbow, pointing his walking stick at weeds as if they were traitors. 'Patience,' he would say, whenever I asked when the tomatoes would be ready. 'Good things grow slowly.' I thought he meant tomatoes. It took me years to realise he didn't."

Why does the writer say Grandad pointed at weeds "as if they were traitors"?
options: To continue the idea of him as a king, in a funny way
To show the weeds were dangerous
questions.answer: To continue the idea of him as a king, in a funny way
questions.explanation: Kings deal with traitors, so it extends the royal metaphor with humour.

questions.question:
Read the passage.

'Patience,' he would say, whenever I asked when the tomatoes would be ready. 'Good things grow slowly.' I thought he meant tomatoes. It took me years to realise he didn't."

"It took me years to realise he didn't." What does the narrator now understand?
options: Grandad was talking about tomatoes only
Grandad's advice was about life, not just gardening
questions.answer: Grandad's advice was about life, not just gardening
questions.explanation: The advice about patience applies to life, which the narrator realises when older.

questions.question: What does "nostalgic" mean?
questions.explanation: Nostalgic means thinking about the past with affection.

questions.question: In a play script, what are stage directions?
options: Instructions about actions, entrances and staging
questions.answer: Instructions about actions, entrances and staging
questions.explanation: Stage directions tell actors what to do and how the stage looks.

questions.question: What is a soliloquy?
options: A speech where a character speaks their thoughts alone on stage
A song for the whole cast
questions.answer: A speech where a character speaks their thoughts alone on stage
questions.explanation: In a soliloquy a character reveals their inner thoughts to the audience.

questions.question: In a P.E.E. paragraph, what does the second E stand for?
questions.explanation: Point, Evidence, Explain: you explain how the evidence supports your point.

questions.question: Which word means "showing kindness and a willingness to give"?
Which is the best way to use a quotation in an answer?
options: Pick a short, relevant phrase and explain it
Use a quote from a different book
questions.answer: Pick a short, relevant phrase and explain it
questions.explanation: Short, embedded quotations with explanation show understanding.
